marks.gloss_en: מתקיף לה רבי זירא: אי הוה כתיב ושרים ישתחוו -- כדקאמרת; השתא דכתיב שרים וישתחוו -- הא והא עבוד: the ministers both rise and bow
as it is written: 'Thus says the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, his Holy One ... kings shall see and arise' (Isa 49:7)
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: I too say: not all are for light, and not all are for gladness
what is the order of fasts? they take the ark out to the city square
the elder among them says words of reproof before them
they stood in prayer: they send down before the ark an elder, practised, who has children and whose house is empty
and he says before them twenty-four blessings: the eighteen of every day, and he adds to them six more
R' Yehuda: rather, in their place he says 'if there be famine in the land, if there be pestilence' (1 Kings 8:37)
for the first he says: He Who answered Abraham on Mount Moriah, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry this day
for the third: He Who answered Joshua at Gilgal, He will answer you...
for the sixth: He Who answered Jonah from the innards of the fish, He will answer you...
